1	"""Minimal signed, expiring tokens for internal service-to-service calls."""
     2	import base64
     3	import calendar
     4	import hashlib
     5	import hmac
     6	import json
     7	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
     8	
     9	SECRET = b"dev-secret-change-me"
    10	
    11	
    12	def _b64(data: bytes) -> str:
    13	    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    14	
    15	
    16	def _unb64(text: str) -> bytes:
    17	    return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(text + "=" * (-len(text) % 4))
    18	
    19	
    20	def _sign(body: str) -> str:
    21	    return _b64(hmac.new(SECRET, body.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest())
    22

    24	def issue(subject, ttl=timedelta(minutes=15), now=None):
    25	    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    26	    exp = calendar.timegm((now + ttl).utctimetuple())
    27	    body = _b64(json.dumps({"sub": subject, "exp": exp}, sort_keys=True).encode())
    28	    return f"{body}.{_sign(body)}"
    29	
    30	
    31	def _claims(token):
    32	    body, _, sig = token.partition(".")
    33	    if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, _sign(body)):
    34	        raise ValueError("bad signature")
    35	    return json.loads(_unb64(body))
    36	
    37	
    38	def verify(token, now=None):
    39	    claims = _claims(token)
    40	    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    41	    if datetime.utcfromtimestamp(claims["exp"]) <= now:
    42	        raise ValueError("token expired")
    43	    return claims
    44	
    45	
    46	def expires_at(token):
    47	    return datetime.utcfromtimestamp(_claims(token)["exp"])

1	"""Minimal signed, expiring tokens for internal service-to-service calls."""
     2	import base64
     3	import calendar
     4	import hashlib
     5	import hmac
     6	import json
     7	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
     8	
     9	SECRET = b"dev-secret-change-me"
    10	
    11	
    12	def _b64(data: bytes) -> str:
    13	    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    14	
    15	
    16	def _unb64(text: str) -> bytes:
    17	    return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(text + "=" * (-len(text) % 4))
    18	
    19	
    20	def _sign(body: str) -> str:
    21	    return _b64(hmac.new(SECRET, body.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest())
    22	
    23	
    24	def issue(subject, ttl=timedelta(minutes=15), now=None):
    25	    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    26	    exp = calendar.timegm((now + ttl).utctimetuple())
    27	    body = _b64(json.dumps({"sub": subject, "exp": exp}, sort_keys=True).encode())
    28	    return f"{body}.{_sign(body)}"
    29	
    30	
    31	def _claims(token):
    32	    body, _, sig = token.partition(".")
    33	    if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, _sign(body)):
    34	        raise ValueError("bad signature")
    35	    return json.loads(_unb64(body))
    36	
    37	
    38	def verify(token, now=None):
    39	    claims = _claims(token)
    40	    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    41	    if datetime.utcfromtimestamp(claims["exp"]) <= now:
    42	        raise ValueError("token expired")
    43	    return claims
    44	
    45	
    46	def expires_at(token):
    47	    return datetime.utcfromtimestamp(_claims(token)["exp"])
